module TensorLibrary where

open import Data.Nat using (ℕ; zero; suc; _+_; _*_; _∸_; _≤_; _<_; _≡ᵇ_)
open import Data.Nat.Properties using (+-comm; *-comm; +-assoc; *-assoc; ≤-refl; ≤-trans; n≤1+n)
open import Data.Fin using (Fin; zero; suc; toℕ; fromℕ<)
open import Data.Vec using (Vec; []; _∷_; map; zipWith; foldr; lookup; replicate; head; tail; length; tabulate; allFin)
open import Data.List using (List; []; _∷_; length; map; foldr; sum; product) renaming (lookup to lookupL)
open import Data.Float using (Float; _+_; _-_; _*_; _/_; _<_; _≤_; exp; log; sin; cos; tan; sqrt; pow; abs) renaming (Float to ℝ)
open import Data.Bool using (Bool; true; false; if_then_else_; _∧_; _∨_)
open import Data.Product using (_×_; _,_; proj₁; proj₂; Σ; ∃)
open import Data.Maybe using (Maybe; just; nothing)
open import Data.Empty using (⊥; ⊥-elim)
open import Relation.Binary.PropositionalEquality using (_≡_; refl; cong; sym; trans; subst)
open import Relation.Nullary using (¬_; Dec; yes; no)
open import Function using (id; _∘_)
open import Data.Unit using (⊤; tt)

infixl 6 _+ℕ_ _∸ℕ_
infixl 7 _*ℕ_

_+ℕ_ = Data.Nat._+_
_*ℕ_ = Data.Nat._*_
_∸ℕ_ = Data.Nat._∸_

prodVec : ∀ {n} → Vec ℕ n → ℕ
prodVec [] = 1
prodVec (x ∷ xs) = x *ℕ prodVec xs

allNonZero : ∀ {n} → Vec ℕ n → Bool
allNonZero [] = true
allNonZero (zero ∷ xs) = false
allNonZero (suc x ∷ xs) = allNonZero xs

computeStrides : ∀ {n} → Vec ℕ n → Vec ℕ n
computeStrides {zero} [] = []
computeStrides {suc zero} (x ∷ []) = 1 ∷ []
computeStrides {suc (suc n)} (x ∷ y ∷ rest) = 
  let sub = computeStrides (y ∷ rest)
      first = head sub *ℕ y
  in first ∷ sub

stridesValid : ∀ {n} (shape : Vec ℕ n) (strides : Vec ℕ n) → Bool
stridesValid [] [] = true
stridesValid (s ∷ ss) (d ∷ ds) = stridesValid ss ds

record Tensor (n : ℕ) : Set where
  constructor mkTensor
  field
    shape : Vec ℕ n
    strides : Vec ℕ n
    data : Vec ℝ (prodVec shape)
    validShape : allNonZero shape ≡ true
    validStrides : stridesValid shape strides ≡ true
    stridesMatch : strides ≡ computeStrides shape

createTensor : ∀ {n} (shp : Vec ℕ n) → allNonZero shp ≡ true → Tensor n
createTensor {n} shp prf = 
  let strd = computeStrides shp
      dt = replicate (prodVec shp) 0.0
  in mkTensor shp strd dt prf refl refl

flatIndex : ∀ {n} → Vec ℕ n → Vec ℕ n → ℕ
flatIndex [] [] = 0
flatIndex (idx ∷ idxs) (stride ∷ strides) = (idx *ℕ stride) +ℕ flatIndex idxs strides

tensorGet : ∀ {n} → Tensor n → Vec ℕ n → ℝ
tensorGet {n} (mkTensor shp strd dt _ _ _) indices = 
  lookup dt (fromℕ< {flatIndex indices strd} {prodVec shp} (n≤1+n (flatIndex indices strd)))

tensorSet : ∀ {n} → Tensor n → Vec ℕ n → ℝ → Tensor n
tensorSet {n} (mkTensor shp strd dt vshp vstrd smatch) indices val = 
  let idx = flatIndex indices strd
      newData = tabulate (λ i → if toℕ i ≡ᵇ idx then val else lookup dt i)
  in mkTensor shp strd newData vshp vstrd smatch

tensorFill : ∀ {n} → Tensor n → ℝ → Tensor n
tensorFill {n} (mkTensor shp strd _ vshp vstrd smatch) val = 
  mkTensor shp strd (replicate (prodVec shp) val) vshp vstrd smatch

tensorMap : ∀ {n} → (ℝ → ℝ) → Tensor n → Tensor n
tensorMap {n} f (mkTensor shp strd dt vshp vstrd smatch) = 
  mkTensor shp strd (map f dt) vshp vstrd smatch

tensorZipWith : ∀ {n} → (ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) → Tensor n → Tensor n → Tensor n
tensorZipWith {n} f (mkTensor shp strd dt1 vshp vstrd smatch) (mkTensor _ _ dt2 _ _ _) = 
  mkTensor shp strd (zipWith f dt1 dt2) vshp vstrd smatch

tensorAdd : ∀ {n} → Tensor n → Tensor n → Tensor n
tensorAdd = tensorZipWith Data.Float._+_

tensorSub : ∀ {n} → Tensor n → Tensor n → Tensor n
tensorSub = tensorZipWith Data.Float._-_

tensorMul : ∀ {n} → Tensor n → Tensor n → Tensor n
tensorMul = tensorZipWith Data.Float._*_

tensorAddScalar : ∀ {n} → Tensor n → ℝ → Tensor n
tensorAddScalar t s = tensorMap (λ x → x Data.Float.+ s) t

tensorMulScalar : ∀ {n} → Tensor n → ℝ → Tensor n
tensorMulScalar t s = tensorMap (λ x → x Data.Float.* s) t

tensorExp : ∀ {n} → Tensor n → Tensor n
tensorExp = tensorMap exp

tensorLog : ∀ {n} → Tensor n → Tensor n
tensorLog = tensorMap log

tensorSin : ∀ {n} → Tensor n → Tensor n
tensorSin = tensorMap sin

tensorCos : ∀ {n} → Tensor n → Tensor n
tensorCos = tensorMap cos

tensorTan : ∀ {n} → Tensor n → Tensor n
tensorTan = tensorMap tan

tensorSqrt : ∀ {n} → Tensor n → Tensor n
tensorSqrt = tensorMap sqrt

tensorAbs : ∀ {n} → Tensor n → Tensor n
tensorAbs = tensorMap abs

tensorRelu : ∀ {n} → Tensor n → Tensor n
tensorRelu = tensorMap (λ x → if x Data.Float.< 0.0 then 0.0 else x)

broadcastCompatible : ∀ {n m} → Vec ℕ n → Vec ℕ m → Bool
broadcastCompatible [] ys = true
broadcastCompatible (x ∷ xs) [] = false
broadcastCompatible {suc n} {suc m} (x ∷ xs) (y ∷ ys) with n ≡ᵇ m
... | false = false
... | true = if (x ≡ᵇ y) ∨ (x ≡ᵇ 1) then broadcastCompatible xs ys else false

broadcast : ∀ {n m} → Tensor n → (target : Vec ℕ m) → Tensor m
broadcast {n} {m} (mkTensor srcShape srcStrides srcData vshp vstrd smatch) targetShape = 
  let newData = tabulate (λ i → 
        let tgtIndices = tabulate {m} (λ _ → 0)
            srcIdx = flatIndex tgtIndices srcStrides
        in lookup srcData (fromℕ< {srcIdx} {prodVec srcShape} (n≤1+n srcIdx)))
      newStrides = computeStrides targetShape
      proof : allNonZero targetShape ≡ true
      proof = refl
  in mkTensor targetShape newStrides newData proof refl refl

dotProduct : ∀ {k} → Vec ℝ k → Vec ℝ k → ℝ
dotProduct [] [] = 0.0
dotProduct (x ∷ xs) (y ∷ ys) = (x Data.Float.* y) Data.Float.+ dotProduct xs ys

getRow : ∀ {m n} → Tensor 2 → ℕ → Vec ℝ n
getRow {m} {n} (mkTensor (rows ∷ cols ∷ []) _ dt _ _ _) i = 
  tabulate (λ j → lookup dt (fromℕ< {i *ℕ cols +ℕ toℕ j} {rows *ℕ cols} (n≤1+n (i *ℕ cols +ℕ toℕ j))))

getCol : ∀ {m n} → Tensor 2 → ℕ → Vec ℝ m
getCol {m} {n} (mkTensor (rows ∷ cols ∷ []) _ dt _ _ _) j = 
  tabulate (λ i → lookup dt (fromℕ< {toℕ i *ℕ cols +ℕ j} {rows *ℕ cols} (n≤1+n (toℕ i *ℕ cols +ℕ j))))

matmul : ∀ {m k n} → Tensor 2 → Tensor 2 → Tensor 2
matmul {m} {k} {n} tA@(mkTensor (rowsA ∷ colsA ∷ []) strA dtA vshpA vstrdA smatchA) 
                    tB@(mkTensor (rowsB ∷ colsB ∷ []) strB dtB vshpB vstrdB smatchB) = 
  let outShape = rowsA ∷ colsB ∷ []
      outStrides = computeStrides outShape
      outData = tabulate {rowsA *ℕ colsB} (λ idx → 
        let i = toℕ idx / colsB
            j = toℕ idx ∸ℕ (i *ℕ colsB)
            rowA = getRow {rowsA} {colsA} tA i
            colB = getCol {rowsB} {colsB} tB j
        in dotProduct rowA colB)
      proof : allNonZero outShape ≡ true
      proof = refl
  in mkTensor outShape outStrides outData proof refl refl

get4DElement : Tensor 4 → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℝ
get4DElement (mkTensor (d0 ∷ d1 ∷ d2 ∷ d3 ∷ []) _ dt _ _ _) i0 i1 i2 i3 = 
  let idx = ((i0 *ℕ d1 +ℕ i1) *ℕ d2 +ℕ i2) *ℕ d3 +ℕ i3
  in lookup dt (fromℕ< {idx} {d0 *ℕ d1 *ℕ d2 *ℕ d3} (n≤1+n idx))

set4DElement : Tensor 4 → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℝ → Tensor 4
set4DElement (mkTensor shp@(d0 ∷ d1 ∷ d2 ∷ d3 ∷ []) strd dt vshp vstrd smatch) i0 i1 i2 i3 val = 
  let idx = ((i0 *ℕ d1 +ℕ i1) *ℕ d2 +ℕ i2) *ℕ d3 +ℕ i3
      newData = tabulate (λ i → if toℕ i ≡ᵇ idx then val else lookup dt i)
  in mkTensor shp strd newData vshp vstrd smatch

conv2dHelper : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Tensor 4 → Tensor 4 → ℝ
conv2dHelper batch outH outW outC b oh ow oc kH kW inC input kernel = 
  conv2dHelperKH batch outH outW outC b oh ow oc kH kW inC 0 input kernel 0.0
  where
    conv2dHelperKH : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Tensor 4 → Tensor 4 → ℝ → ℝ
    conv2dHelperKH batch outH outW outC b oh ow oc zero kW inC kh input kernel acc = acc
    conv2dHelperKH batch outH outW outC b oh ow oc (suc kH) kW inC kh input kernel acc = 
      let accKW = conv2dHelperKW batch outH outW outC b oh ow oc (suc kH) kW inC kh 0 input kernel acc
      in conv2dHelperKH batch outH outW outC b oh ow oc kH kW inC (suc kh) input kernel accKW
    
    conv2dHelperKW : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Tensor 4 → Tensor 4 → ℝ → ℝ
    conv2dHelperKW batch outH outW outC b oh ow oc kH zero inC kh kw input kernel acc = acc
    conv2dHelperKW batch outH outW outC b oh ow oc kH (suc kW) inC kh kw input kernel acc = 
      let accIC = conv2dHelperIC batch outH outW outC b oh ow oc kH (suc kW) inC kh kw 0 input kernel acc
      in conv2dHelperKW batch outH outW outC b oh ow oc kH kW inC kh (suc kw) input kernel accIC
    
    conv2dHelperIC : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Tensor 4 → Tensor 4 → ℝ → ℝ
    conv2dHelperIC batch outH outW outC b oh ow oc kH kW zero kh kw ic input kernel acc = acc
    conv2dHelperIC batch outH outW outC b oh ow oc kH kW (suc inC) kh kw ic input kernel acc = 
      let ih = oh +ℕ kh
          iw = ow +ℕ kw
          inputVal = get4DElement input b ih iw ic
          kernelVal = get4DElement kernel kh kw ic oc
          newAcc = acc Data.Float.+ (inputVal Data.Float.* kernelVal)
      in conv2dHelperIC batch outH outW outC b oh ow oc kH kW inC kh kw (suc ic) input kernel newAcc

conv2d : ∀ {batch inH inW inC kH kW outC} → Tensor 4 → Tensor 4 → ℕ → ℕ → Tensor 4
conv2d {batch} {inH} {inW} {inC} {kH} {kW} {outC} input@(mkTensor inShape _ _ _ _ _) kernel@(mkTensor kShape _ _ _ _ _) strideH strideW = 
  let outH = (inH ∸ℕ kH) / strideH +ℕ 1
      outW = (inW ∸ℕ kW) / strideW +ℕ 1
      outShape = batch ∷ outH ∷ outW ∷ outC ∷ []
      outStrides = computeStrides outShape
      outData = tabulate {batch *ℕ outH *ℕ outW *ℕ outC} (λ idx → 
        let flatIdx = toℕ idx
            b = flatIdx / (outH *ℕ outW *ℕ outC)
            rem1 = flatIdx ∸ℕ (b *ℕ outH *ℕ outW *ℕ outC)
            oh = rem1 / (outW *ℕ outC)
            rem2 = rem1 ∸ℕ (oh *ℕ outW *ℕ outC)
            ow = rem2 / outC
            oc = rem2 ∸ℕ (ow *ℕ outC)
        in conv2dHelper batch outH outW outC b oh ow oc kH kW inC input kernel)
      proof : allNonZero outShape ≡ true
      proof = refl
  in mkTensor outShape outStrides outData proof refl refl

tensorReshape : ∀ {n m} → Tensor n → (newShape : Vec ℕ m) → Tensor m
tensorReshape {n} {m} (mkTensor oldShape _ dt _ _ _) newShape = 
  let newStrides = computeStrides newShape
      proof : allNonZero newShape ≡ true
      proof = refl
  in mkTensor newShape newStrides dt proof refl refl

tensorTranspose : ∀ {n} → Tensor n → Vec ℕ n → Tensor n
tensorTranspose {n} (mkTensor shp strd dt vshp vstrd smatch) axes = 
  let newShape = tabulate (λ i → lookup shp (lookup (tabulate id) (fromℕ< {toℕ i} {n} (n≤1+n (toℕ i)))))
      newStrides = tabulate (λ i → lookup strd (lookup (tabulate id) (fromℕ< {toℕ i} {n} (n≤1+n (toℕ i)))))
      proof : allNonZero newShape ≡ true
      proof = refl
  in mkTensor newShape newStrides dt proof refl refl

reduceSum : ∀ {n} → Tensor n → Tensor n
reduceSum {n} (mkTensor shp strd dt vshp vstrd smatch) = 
  let sumVal = foldr (λ x acc → x Data.Float.+ acc) 0.0 dt
      outShape = replicate n 1
      outData = sumVal ∷ []
      proof : allNonZero outShape ≡ true
      proof = refl
      outStrides = computeStrides outShape
  in mkTensor outShape outStrides outData proof refl refl

tensorZeros : ∀ {n} → (shape : Vec ℕ n) → allNonZero shape ≡ true → Tensor n
tensorZeros = createTensor

tensorOnes : ∀ {n} → (shape : Vec ℕ n) → allNonZero shape ≡ true → Tensor n
tensorOnes {n} shape prf = 
  let t = createTensor shape prf
  in tensorFill t 1.0

eye : ∀ {n} → ℕ → Tensor 2
eye {n} size = 
  let shape = size ∷ size ∷ []
      strides = computeStrides shape
      dt = tabulate {size *ℕ size} (λ i → 
        let row = toℕ i / size
            col = toℕ i ∸ℕ (row *ℕ size)
        in if row ≡ᵇ col then 1.0 else 0.0)
      proof : allNonZero shape ≡ true
      proof = refl
  in mkTensor shape strides dt proof refl refl

prodVec : ∀ {n} → Vec ℕ n → ℕ
prodVec [] = 1
prodVec (x ∷ xs) = x * prodVec xs

allNonZero : ∀ {n} → Vec ℕ n → Bool
allNonZero [] = true
allNonZero (zero ∷ xs) = false
allNonZero (suc x ∷ xs) = allNonZero xs

computeStrides : ∀ {n} → Vec ℕ n → Vec ℕ n
computeStrides {zero} [] = []
computeStrides {suc zero} (x ∷ []) = 1 ∷ []
computeStrides {suc (suc n)} (x ∷ y ∷ rest) with computeStrides (y ∷ rest)
... | (s ∷ ss) = (s * y) ∷ (s ∷ ss)

stridesValid : ∀ {n} (shape : Vec ℕ n) (strides : Vec ℕ n) → Bool
stridesValid [] [] = true
stridesValid (s ∷ ss) (d ∷ ds) = stridesValid ss ds

record Tensor (n : ℕ) : Set where
  constructor mkTensor
  field
    shape : Vec ℕ n
    strides : Vec ℕ n
    data : Vec ℝ (prodVec shape)
    validShape : allNonZero shape ≡ true
    validStrides : stridesValid shape strides ≡ true
    stridesMatch : strides ≡ computeStrides shape

createTensor : ∀ {n} (shp : Vec ℕ n) → allNonZero shp ≡ true → Tensor n
createTensor {n} shp prf = mkTensor shp (computeStrides shp) (replicate (prodVec shp) 0.0) prf refl refl

flatIndex : ∀ {n} → Vec ℕ n → Vec ℕ n → ℕ
flatIndex [] [] = 0
flatIndex (idx ∷ idxs) (stride ∷ strides) = (idx * stride) + flatIndex idxs strides

boundProof : ∀ {n} (idx : ℕ) (size : ℕ) → idx < size → Fin size
boundProof idx size prf = fromℕ< prf

safeIndex : ∀ {n} (idx : ℕ) (size : ℕ) → Fin size
safeIndex zero zero = fromℕ< (s≤s z≤n)
safeIndex zero (suc size) = fromℕ< (s≤s z≤n)
safeIndex (suc idx) zero = fromℕ< (s≤s z≤n)
safeIndex (suc idx) (suc size) = inject≤ (safeIndex idx size) (n≤1+n size)

tensorGet : ∀ {n} → Tensor n → Vec ℕ n → ℝ
tensorGet {n} (mkTensor shp strd dt _ _ _) indices = lookup dt (safeIndex (flatIndex indices strd) (prodVec shp))

tensorSet : ∀ {n} → Tensor n → Vec ℕ n → ℝ → Tensor n
tensorSet {n} (mkTensor shp strd dt vshp vstrd smatch) indices val = 
  let idx = flatIndex indices strd
      newData = tabulate (λ i → if toℕ i ≡ᵇ idx then val else lookup dt i)
  in mkTensor shp strd newData vshp vstrd smatch

tensorFill : ∀ {n} → Tensor n → ℝ → Tensor n
tensorFill {n} (mkTensor shp strd _ vshp vstrd smatch) val = mkTensor shp strd (replicate (prodVec shp) val) vshp vstrd smatch

tensorMap : ∀ {n} → (ℝ → ℝ) → Tensor n → Tensor n
tensorMap {n} f (mkTensor shp strd dt vshp vstrd smatch) = mkTensor shp strd (map f dt) vshp vstrd smatch

tensorZipWith {n} f (mkTensor shp strd dt1 vshp vstrd smatch) (mkTensor _ _ dt2 _ _ _) = mkTensor shp strd (zipWith f dt1 dt2) vshp vstrd smatch

tensorAdd : ∀ {n} → Tensor n → Tensor n → Tensor n
tensorAdd = tensorZipWith _+_

tensorSub : ∀ {n} → Tensor n → Tensor n → Tensor n
tensorSub = tensorZipWith _-_

tensorMul : ∀ {n} → Tensor n → Tensor n → Tensor n

tensorAddScalar : ∀ {n} → Tensor n → ℝ → Tensor n

tensorMulScalar : ∀ {n} → Tensor n → ℝ → Tensor n

tensorExp : ∀ {n} → Tensor n → Tensor n

tensorLog : ∀ {n} → Tensor n → Tensor n

tensorSin : ∀ {n} → Tensor n → Tensor n
tensorSin = tensorMap sin

tensorCos : ∀ {n} → Tensor n → Tensor n
tensorCos = tensorMap cos

tensorTan : ∀ {n} → Tensor n → Tensor n
tensorTan = tensorMap tan

tensorSqrt : ∀ {n} → Tensor n → Tensor n
tensorSqrt = tensorMap sqrt

tensorAbs : ∀ {n} → Tensor n → Tensor n
tensorAbs = tensorMap abs

tensorRelu : ∀ {n} → Tensor n → Tensor n

broadcastIdx : ∀ {n m} → Vec ℕ m → Vec ℕ n → Vec ℕ m → Vec ℕ n
broadcastIdx {zero} {m} targetIndices srcShape targetShape = []
broadcastIdx {suc n} {zero} targetIndices srcShape targetShape = 0 ∷ broadcastIdx {n} {zero} [] (tail srcShape) []
broadcastIdx {suc n} {suc m} (ti ∷ tis) (ss ∷ sss) (ts ∷ tss) = (if ss ≡ᵇ 1 then 0 else ti) ∷ broadcastIdx tis sss tss

broadcast {n} {m} (mkTensor srcShape srcStrides srcData vshp vstrd smatch) targetShape tprf = 
  let newStrides = computeStrides targetShape
      newData = tabulate (λ i → 
        let flatIdx = toℕ i
            tgtIndices = tabulate {m} (λ j → (flatIdx / prodVec (tail (tabulate {m} (λ k → if toℕ j <ᵇ toℕ k then lookup targetShape k else 1)))) % lookup targetShape j)

            srcIdx = flatIndex srcIndices srcStrides
        in lookup srcData (safeIndex srcIdx (prodVec srcShape)))
  in mkTensor targetShape newStrides newData tprf refl refl

dotProduct : ∀ {k} → Vec ℝ k → Vec ℝ k → ℝ
dotProduct [] [] = 0.0
dotProduct (x ∷ xs) (y ∷ ys) = (x * y) + dotProduct xs ys

getRow : ∀ {m n} → Tensor 2 → ℕ → Vec ℝ n
getRow {m} {n} (mkTensor (rows ∷ cols ∷ []) _ dt _ _ _) i = tabulate (λ j → lookup dt (safeIndex (i * cols + toℕ j) (rows * cols)))

getCol : ∀ {m n} → Tensor 2 → ℕ → Vec ℝ m
getCol {m} {n} (mkTensor (rows ∷ cols ∷ []) _ dt _ _ _) j = tabulate (λ i → lookup dt (safeIndex (toℕ i * cols + j) (rows * cols)))

matmul : ∀ {m k n} → Tensor 2 → Tensor 2 → Tensor 2
matmul {m} {k} {n} tA@(mkTensor (rowsA ∷ colsA ∷ []) strA dtA vshpA vstrdA smatchA) tB@(mkTensor (rowsB ∷ colsB ∷ []) strB dtB vshpB vstrdB smatchB) = 
  let outShape = rowsA ∷ colsB ∷ []
      outStrides = computeStrides outShape
      outData = tabulate {rowsA * colsB} (λ idx → 
        let flatIdx = toℕ idx
            i = flatIdx / colsB
            j = flatIdx ∸ (i * colsB)
            rowA = getRow {rowsA} {colsA} tA i
            colB = getCol {rowsB} {colsB} tB j
        in dotProduct rowA colB)
      proof : allNonZero outShape ≡ true
      proof = refl
  in mkTensor outShape outStrides outData proof refl refl

get4DElement : Tensor 4 → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℝ
get4DElement (mkTensor (d0 ∷ d1 ∷ d2 ∷ d3 ∷ []) _ dt _ _ _) i0 i1 i2 i3 = 
  let idx = ((i0 * d1 + i1) * d2 + i2) * d3 + i3
  in lookup dt (safeIndex idx (d0 * d1 * d2 * d3))

set4DElement : Tensor 4 → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℝ → Tensor 4
set4DElement (mkTensor shp@(d0 ∷ d1 ∷ d2 ∷ d3 ∷ []) strd dt vshp vstrd smatch) i0 i1 i2 i3 val = 
  let idx = ((i0 * d1 + i1) * d2 + i2) * d3 + i3
      newData = tabulate (λ i → if toℕ i ≡ᵇ idx then val else lookup dt i)
  in mkTensor shp strd newData vshp vstrd smatch

conv2dInnerLoop : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Tensor 4 → Tensor 4 → ℝ
conv2dInnerLoop kH kW inC b oh ow oc strideH strideW zero zero zero input kernel = 0.0
conv2dInnerLoop kH kW inC b oh ow oc strideH strideW zero zero (suc ic) input kernel = 
  let ih = oh * strideH
      iw = ow * strideW
      inputVal = get4DElement input b ih iw ic
      kernelVal = get4DElement kernel 0 0 ic oc
      prev = conv2dInnerLoop kH kW inC b oh ow oc strideH strideW 0 0 ic input kernel
  in prev + (inputVal * kernelVal)
conv2dInnerLoop kH kW inC b oh ow oc strideH strideW zero (suc kw) ic input kernel = 
  let ih = oh * strideH
      iw = ow * strideW + kw
      inputVal = get4DElement input b ih iw ic
      kernelVal = get4DElement kernel 0 kw ic oc
      prev = conv2dInnerLoop kH kW inC b oh ow oc strideH strideW 0 kw ic input kernel
      nextIC = conv2dInnerLoop kH kW inC b oh ow oc strideH strideW 0 (suc kw) 0 input kernel
  in if ic ≡ᵇ (inC ∸ 1) then nextIC + (inputVal * kernelVal) else prev + (inputVal * kernelVal)
conv2dInnerLoop kH kW inC b oh ow oc strideH strideW (suc kh) kw ic input kernel = 
  let ih = oh * strideH + kh
      iw = ow * strideW + kw
      inputVal = get4DElement input b ih iw ic
      kernelVal = get4DElement kernel kh kw ic oc
      prev = conv2dInnerLoop kH kW inC b oh ow oc strideH strideW kh kw ic input kernel
      nextKW = if kw ≡ᵇ (kW ∸ 1) then conv2dInnerLoop kH kW inC b oh ow oc strideH strideW (suc kh) 0 0 input kernel else conv2dInnerLoop kH kW inC b oh ow oc strideH strideW (suc kh) (suc kw) 0 input kernel
  in if ic ≡ᵇ (inC ∸ 1) then (if kw ≡ᵇ (kW ∸ 1) then nextKW + (inputVal * kernelVal) else prev + (inputVal * kernelVal)) else prev + (inputVal * kernelVal)

conv2dAcc : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Tensor 4 → Tensor 4 → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℝ
conv2dAcc kH kW inC b oh ow oc strideH strideW zero zero zero input kernel khAcc kwAcc icAcc = 0.0
conv2dAcc kH kW inC b oh ow oc strideH strideW zero zero (suc ic) input kernel khAcc kwAcc icAcc = 
  let ih = oh * strideH + khAcc
      iw = ow * strideW + kwAcc
      inputVal = get4DElement input b ih iw icAcc
      kernelVal = get4DElement kernel khAcc kwAcc icAcc oc
      rest = conv2dAcc kH kW inC b oh ow oc strideH strideW 0 0 ic input kernel khAcc kwAcc (suc icAcc)
  in (inputVal * kernelVal) + rest
conv2dAcc kH kW inC b oh ow oc strideH strideW zero (suc kw) ic input kernel khAcc kwAcc icAcc = 
  let prevIC = conv2dAcc kH kW inC b oh ow oc strideH strideW 0 0 inC input kernel khAcc kwAcc 0
      rest = conv2dAcc kH kW inC b oh ow oc strideH strideW 0 kw ic input kernel khAcc (suc kwAcc) 0
  in prevIC + rest
conv2dAcc kH kW inC b oh ow oc strideH strideW (suc kh) kw ic input kernel khAcc kwAcc icAcc = 
  let prevKW = conv2dAcc kH kW inC b oh ow oc strideH strideW 0 kW 0 input kernel khAcc 0 0
      rest = conv2dAcc kH kW inC b oh ow oc strideH strideW kh kw ic input kernel (suc khAcc) 0 0
  in prevKW + rest

conv2dCompute : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Tensor 4 → Tensor 4 → ℝ
conv2dCompute kH kW inC b oh ow oc strideH strideW khCnt kwCnt icCnt input kernel = conv2dComputeKH kH kW inC b oh ow oc strideH strideW khCnt kwCnt icCnt input kernel 0.0 where
  conv2dComputeKH : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Tensor 4 → Tensor 4 → ℝ → ℝ
  conv2dComputeKH zero kW inC b oh ow oc strideH strideW zero kwCnt icCnt input kernel acc = acc
  conv2dComputeKH (suc kH) kW inC b oh ow oc strideH strideW khCnt kwCnt icCnt input kernel acc = 
    let newAcc = conv2dComputeKW kH kW inC b oh ow oc strideH strideW khCnt kwCnt icCnt input kernel acc
    in conv2dComputeKH kH kW inC b oh ow oc strideH strideW (suc khCnt) 0 0 input kernel newAcc
  
  conv2dComputeKW : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Tensor 4 → Tensor 4 → ℝ → ℝ
  conv2dComputeKW kH zero inC b oh ow oc strideH strideW khCnt zero icCnt input kernel acc = acc
  conv2dComputeKW kH (suc kW) inC b oh ow oc strideH strideW khCnt kwCnt icCnt input kernel acc = 
    let newAcc = conv2dComputeIC kH kW inC b oh ow oc strideH strideW khCnt kwCnt icCnt input kernel acc
    in conv2dComputeKW kH kW inC b oh ow oc strideH strideW khCnt (suc kwCnt) 0 input kernel newAcc
  
  conv2dComputeIC : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Tensor 4 → Tensor 4 → ℝ → ℝ
  conv2dComputeIC kH kW zero b oh ow oc strideH strideW khCnt kwCnt zero input kernel acc = acc
  conv2dComputeIC kH kW (suc inC) b oh ow oc strideH strideW khCnt kwCnt icCnt input kernel acc = 
    let ih = oh * strideH + khCnt
        iw = ow * strideW + kwCnt
        inputVal = get4DElement input b ih iw icCnt
        kernelVal = get4DElement kernel khCnt kwCnt icCnt oc
        newAcc = acc + (inputVal * kernelVal)
    in conv2dComputeIC kH kW inC b oh ow oc strideH strideW khCnt kwCnt (suc icCnt) input kernel newAcc

conv2d : ∀ {batch inH inW inC kH kW outC} → Tensor 4 → Tensor 4 → ℕ → ℕ → Tensor 4
conv2d {batch} {inH} {inW} {inC} {kH} {kW} {outC} input@(mkTensor inShape _ _ _ _ _) kernel@(mkTensor kShape _ _ _ _ _) strideH strideW = 
  let outH = (inH ∸ kH) / strideH + 1
      outW = (inW ∸ kW) / strideW + 1
      outShape = batch ∷ outH ∷ outW ∷ outC ∷ []
      outStrides = computeStrides outShape
      outData = tabulate {batch * outH * outW * outC} (λ idx → 
        let flatIdx = toℕ idx
            b = flatIdx / (outH * outW * outC)
            rem1 = flatIdx ∸ (b * outH * outW * outC)
            oh = rem1 / (outW * outC)
            rem2 = rem1 ∸ (oh * outW * outC)
            ow = rem2 / outC
            oc = rem2 ∸ (ow * outC)
        in conv2dCompute kH kW inC b oh ow oc strideH strideW kH kW inC input kernel)
      proof : allNonZero outShape ≡ true
      proof = refl
  in mkTensor outShape outStrides outData proof refl refl

tensorReshape : ∀ {n m} → Tensor n → (newShape : Vec ℕ m) → allNonZero newShape ≡ true → Tensor m
tensorReshape {n} {m} (mkTensor oldShape _ dt _ _ _) newShape prf = 
  let newStrides = computeStrides newShape
  in mkTensor newShape newStrides dt prf refl refl

tensorZeros : ∀ {n} → (shape : Vec ℕ n) → allNonZero shape ≡ true → Tensor n
tensorZeros = createTensor

tensorOnes : ∀ {n} → (shape : Vec ℕ n) → allNonZero shape ≡ true → Tensor n
tensorOnes {n} shape prf = tensorFill (createTensor shape prf) 1.0

eye : ∀ {n} → ℕ → Tensor 2
eye {n} size = 
  let shape = size ∷ size ∷ []
      strides = computeStrides shape
      dt = tabulate {size * size} (λ i → 
        let row = toℕ i / size
            col = toℕ i ∸ (row * size)
        in if row ≡ᵇ col then 1.0 else 0.0)
      proof : allNonZero shape ≡ true
      proof = refl
  in mkTensor shape strides dt proof refl refl

reduceSum : ∀ {n} → Tensor n → ℝ
reduceSum {n} (mkTensor shp strd dt vshp vstrd smatch) = foldr (λ x acc → x + acc) 0.0 dt

reduceMean : ∀ {n} → Tensor n → ℝ
reduceMean {n} t@(mkTensor shp strd dt vshp vstrd smatch) = 
  let total = reduceSum t
      count = prodVec shp
  in total ÷ Data.Float.fromℕ count where
